meta.name: Arrows
meta.tag: Slide every arrow off the board

hub.tagline: Tap an arrow to send it flying the way it points. Clear the board without crashing into the others.

all.title: Tap an arrow to launch it
all.desc: An arrow slides out the way its head points, its body following every bend. If nothing is in its way, it leaves the board.

all.title: Blocked arrows bounce back
all.desc: If another arrow is in the way, yours bumps into it and slides back -- costing one of your 3 hearts. Lose them all and the board restarts.

all.title: Clear the way, then clear the board
all.desc: Launching one arrow can free the ones behind it. Pinch to zoom and drag to move around big boards. Clear every arrow to win.

game.hintFailToast: No arrow can be launched right now.
game.winSubtitle: Every arrow found its way out — next board unlocked.
game.failSubtitle: Too many crashes. Restart the board and try a new route.
